analysis_source:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
root=Path.cwd()
d=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_dealer_expectation_source_probe_v1'
assert not (d/'result.json').exists(),'E5已裁决，不覆盖'
text=(d/'auction_survey_202311.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
compact=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text)
assert 'Aggregated Perspectives on Treasury Auction Sizes, October 2023' in compact
assert 'all 24 primary dealers' in compact and 'trimmed mean' in compact and 'trimmed standard deviation' in compact
assert all(x in compact for x in ['FY24','FY25','FY26','Year-End'])
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
result={
 'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_DEALER_EXPECTATION_SOURCE_PROBE_V1','experiment_id':'E5_SOURCE_PROBE','completed_at':stamp,
 'status':'COMPLETED_AGGREGATED_EXPECTATIONS_PRESENT_SHORT_HORIZON_NOT_MATCHED',
 'source_type':'财政部对一级交易商的已填汇总调查结果，不是空白问卷，也不是财政部发行承诺。',
 'survey_period_printed':'October 2023','pdf_file':'auction_survey_202311.pdf',
 'forecast_horizons':['FY24 year-end','FY25 year-end','FY26 year-end'],
 'dealer_responses':24,'reported_estimators':['trimmed mean','trimmed standard deviation'],
 'trimming_rule':'每一期限删除24份回答中最高和最低后计算，保留22份；不是普通24机构均值。',
 'range_field_meaning':'各机构认为不意外的规模上下界之汇总，并非置信区间、分位数或下一季度共识。',
 'amount_scope':'auction size净掉SOMA add-ons；新发/续发分别列，不是净新增财政融资。',
 'aggregate_coupon_rows':10,'tips_rows':6,'frn_rows':2,'bill_rows':6,'numeric_outlook_horizons':3,
 'sample_source_available':True,'direct_next_quarter_or_january2024_consensus_available':False,
 'calendar_quarter_complete_source_established':False,'directory_labels':'每年列Q2/Q4；打印调查月为四月/十月。目录标签不能当四季预测时钟。',
 'printed_survey_month_is_publication_time':False,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
 'short_horizon_surprise_score_status':'NOT_RUN_FORECAST_HORIZON_NOT_MATCHED',
 'new_market_expectation_gap_computed':False,'new_price_or_stock_returns_loaded':False,
 'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'account_net_sharpe':None,'goal_achieved':False,
 'new_repository_code_edits':0,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'independent_validation':False,
 'conclusion':'接受机构长期供给预期及其分布存在；拒绝将年末预测错当下一季度或1月规模共识。当前短期限预期差路线结束，不下载更多同类文件来填补不匹配的目标。',
 'next_research_question':'E6仅提案检验实际季度计划的长端供给状态变化：固定2022—2025季度安排，字段为100×(未来3月10/20/30年常规券gross规模/之前3月同范围gross规模−1)，称供给状态而非市场意外或净流动性；同池低复杂度匹配对照，只有真正增量才进入账户。',
}
(d/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
r=json.loads((d/'原调查渲染回执.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
r['visually_checked']=True
r['visual_review_at']=stamp
r['visual_result']='完整一页已读：三类财政年末表头、规模/不意外上下界、均值/标准差、24机构剔除两极端脚注，未改写PDF。'
(d/'原调查渲染回执.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
next_q={
 'experiment_id':'E6','status':'PROPOSED_SINGLE_QUARTERLY_CAUSE_INCREMENT_NOT_RUN',
 'question':'不同于名义/实质利率结果，已经公开的下一季度长端常规券供给增幅，是否在原M2月度资金状态之外改变指数可成交收益判断？',
 'historical_scope':'2022—2025按季度公布日固定的16次安排，主比较2024—2025；不是挑收益较好月份。',
 'one_primary_field':'100×(预告未来三月10/20/30年常规固定利率券gross规模/此前三月同范围已知gross规模−1)',
 'source_units':'仅原期限10/20/30年，包含其新发与续发一次；排除2/3/5/7、TIPS、FRN及Bill。',
 'reason_for_one_field':'避免将主要来自短中期规模的扩张误命名长端期限供给；季度三月合计平衡新发/续发月度安排。',
 'control':'原M2九变量和相同可得成熟事件池、同一时点控制；联合仅加此项。沿用冻结低复杂度、费用标签与分数线，不搜索方向/阈值/深度。',
 'necessary_checks':['来源字段和可知时点一致','只用成熟标签','所有事件和反例','真实费用/权益约束','共同事件池与季度根数分开报告'],
 'source_reconstruction_boundary':'首版未认证必须保留；预告公布不能称当年真实采集。失配或缺表不能补零，不由事后收益补金额。',
 'when_to_score':'全部固定来源可提取并先登记唯一表达，再查看新分组收益；本提案没有新拟合。',
 'independent_root_boundary':'月度事件共享同季度计划不变，不能把月份填充增加成独立政策冲击。',
 'not_claimed':['市场意外','净流动性抽离','外生冲击','独立策略有效'],
 'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,
}
for directory in [d,root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1']:
    (directory/'next_source_question.json').write_text(json.dumps(next_q,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
# 原表固定示例：并未用收益挑选表达或期限。
plan=json.loads((root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1/季度提前计划_原图转录.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
before=sum(sum(plan['months'][m][4:]) for m in ['Aug-23','Sep-23','Oct-23'])
after=sum(sum(plan['months'][m][4:]) for m in ['Nov-23','Dec-23','Jan-24'])
illustration={'date':'2023-11-01','source_table_reference':'20231101季度计划表.PNG','previous_three_month_long_coupon_gross_billion_usd':before,'next_three_month_long_coupon_gross_billion_usd':after,
 'proposed_field_percent':100*(after/before-1),'status':'SOURCE_ONLY_EXPRESSION_ILLUSTRATION_NOT_SCORE',
 'one_policy_root':True,'stock_returns_loaded':False,'new_model_fits':0,'market_surprise':False,'net_liquidity':False}
(d/'下一字段原表演示_不含收益.json').write_text(json.dumps(illustration,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'E5裁决':result['status'],'机构':24,'保留机构每期限':22,'年末时段':3,'短期共识':False,'下一字段来源演示':illustration['proposed_field_percent'],'新增拟合':0,'新增账户':0},ensure_ascii=False))
